environment: Headless desktop Chromium; no phone CPU emulation; detailed profiling disabled during timings

contextCalls.description: One warm high-quality character frame; drawing/path/transform methods, excluding state assignments

method.fullCharacter: Same browser page; alternate original/candidate top draw methods; 24 bodies, two thirds moving; 60 warmup frames then 600 measured frames per interval, four intervals per variant
method.garmentOnly: Same page; 24 garment draws per frame, female curvy body, six common tops; 100 warmup frames then 1500 measured frames per interval, four intervals per variant

interpretation: Context-call reduction is modest. Isolated garment timing is slightly lower, but full-character timing does not establish an overall CPU improvement. Neither test predicts phone FPS.
rejectedPrototype: Per-limb retained paths were tested and removed: moving and idle-pose geometry often changes, and caching/allocation overhead did not justify enabling them.
